topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: Rain was sleeting down the window when I got the call. Old teacher, voice a little wobbly, talking about a gift from a student she thought was just another part of the crowd. "Alasting memory," she said, like she was trying to convince herself it was a big deal. I’ve seen those eyes before, hoping the past can surprise you, make it all worth it. I told her I’d look into it, but the words felt heavy. Out here, you learn the world’s a shade darker than what they teach in school. I was supposed to be the one who keeps the shadows at bay, but things get complicated, and the line between helping and hurting blurs. I just wish it didn’t have to be this way.
